title: Harnessing magnetic, photo, and thermal fields and their synergistic interactions for enhanced electrocatalytic oxygen evolution reaction
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00574D, Review Article
Yuan Cao, Linfeng Gao, Yijiang Liu, Zhiqun Lin
This review highlights recent progress in harnessing magnetic, photo, and thermal fields and their synergistic coupling to enhance electrocatalytic oxygen evolution reaction, with emphasis on underlying mechanisms and design strategies.
